title: VOXELWARS MS: the campaign of one era (nine missions, six puzzles), msVersion 1
description: Validated by tools/ms_lint.mjs (a JSON Schema 2020-12 subset interpreter: type enum const properties required additionalProperties items minItems maxItems minLength maxLength minimum maximum pattern uniqueItems oneOf anyOf allOf if/then $ref). x-vocab is the closed vocabulary the lint reads; spec/MS.md documents it.

anchor.description: camera/aim anchor: player_line | enemy_centroid | unit:<defId> | <markerId> of this mission (resolved by the lint)

arenaProp.description: decor/dressing prop placed by the mission (Ancient shape {t,x,z,r?,s?,v?})

env.description: env overrides: weather, time, fog, wind, theme, sky, gravity (checked by the lint against the closed lists)

parSpec.description: par defined ONCE: cost = money in fmtCost units, time = seconds, none = value 0

override.description: closed per-group/per-fixed-unit patch (compiled to a def patch by the generator); Ancient fixed[].def keeps its open shape in `def`

when.description: M14 `at`: battle seconds, or a trigger

oneOf.description: render-only time-of-day jump (Sci-Fi R10); no sim state

scriptEvent.description: repeat is generator sugar for a timed event: it expands to `times` events (ids <id>_1.._n) at at, at+every, ...; every expanded event counts toward the 64-event limit

counterRule.description: a mission-local counter rule (same language as x-vocab.counters); ids are prefixed with the era prefix

zeus.description: Ancient legacy (Zeus strikes); new eras use events[].do[].strike

starTest.description: star 1: {id:"win"}; star 2: aliveCostFrac [0.5]; star 3: any other helper of x-vocab.helpers

beat.description: CU5 teaching beat; basics beats are the once-ever layer

teachingException.description: a declared cameo of a mechanic taught LATER (the untaught rule); units are checked, props and powers are documentation

shotPoint.description: anchor + [dx, height above ground, dz] in units

setpiece.description: SETPIECES registry row (CU3) as authored; trigger null = emitted by the content-layer MissionRuntime timer or by a script setpiece op; a trigger is compiled to a script event

firstThree.description: mission 1 only: the index of design/<era>/first_three_minutes.md (ids parsed from the md by the lint and compared)

powers.description: COORD decision: rules.powers.disable / rules.powers.override are real

input.description: scripted inputs of the reference run (campaign_play step 6)

legacy.description: Ancient only: constants of the shipped campaign_text.js/campaign.js that new eras express elsewhere (MUTATOR_STARS, TEACHING_SKIP, TEACHING_BEATS)

aliveCostFrac.doc: cost(aliveRoster ?? aliveDefs) / (playerCostStart > 0 ? playerCostStart : 1) >= f; cost from the era stat table; the Ancient star-2 test with f = 0.5

thrift.doc: playerCostStart <= par (Ancient T.thrift); forbidden when the mission has fixed[] (their cost is in playerCostStart): use spentAtMost

spentAtMost.doc: (spent !== undefined ? spent : playerCostStart) <= par (the puzzle par star)

noLoss.doc: sum(startDefs[d], d in defs) >= minFielded (default 1) AND sum(lostDefs[d]) === 0 (Ancient noSpartanLost = noLoss([spartan], 6))

keptAlive.doc: (aliveRoster ?? aliveDefs)[def] >= n (Ancient elephantAlive = keptAlive(war_elephant, 1)); roster units only (bailed-out, summoned and reinforcement units are excluded)

propDownBy.doc: propDownT[type] non-empty AND min(propDownT[type]) <= secs (Ancient gateFast)

heroesAlive.doc: at least one unit of a def in context.heroes fielded AND (heroesLost|0) === 0 (Ancient heroesAlive)

usedMechanic.doc: counters[mechanics[id].counter] >= n; n counts the unit of the counter (events or hit points, x-vocab.mechanics)

usedAll.doc: for every id in ids: counters[mechanics[id].counter] >= n

propStanding.doc: (propsAlive[type]|0) >= 1 at the battle end (props with hit points left)

burnKills.doc: (countersBy.fire_kill[tag]|0) >= n; tag is a def tag of the killed unit

shellsOnTarget.doc: (countersBy.shell_hit[def]|0) >= n; shell_hit counts indirect-fire hits on a unit of def

hitsDuringReload.doc: counters.reload_hit >= n (hits the player dealt to an enemy in its reload state)

bannerDownBy.doc: firstT['banner_fall:' + def] <= secs (first enemy banner of that def to fall)

coverFracAtLeast.doc: unit_ticks > 0 AND cover_unit_ticks / unit_ticks >= f (share of the player unit-seconds spent in cover)

hitsWhileReloadingAtMost.doc: (counters.reload_hit_taken|0) <= n (hits taken by the player units while the hit unit was reloading)

coreHpAtLeast.doc: coreHpFrac !== null AND coreHpFrac >= f (hit points of the defended core prop at the battle end / its maximum)

enemyDownBy.doc: enemyDownT[def] non-empty AND enemyDownT[def][0] <= secs (puzzle bonus elephant_fast)

summaryAtMost.doc: (summary[field]|0) <= n for a field of x-vocab.summaryFields (puzzle bonus no_stone = summaryAtMost(stonedUnits, 0))

brace_break.doc: a braced pike stopped a charge (existing event unit_brace {id: bracer, dst: charger}, combat.js:289)

needs: event banner_fall {id, def, team, x, z, allies}
banner_fall.doc: an enemy banner carrier fell or its banner was cut (NEW event); firstT[banner_fall:<def>] and countersBy.banner_fall[def]

bolt_heavy_hit.doc: armour-piercing (ap >= .5) hits on a target with armour >= .4

needs: event unit_bailout {id, def, n, x, z}
unhorse.doc: an enemy mount died and its rider stood up

props_siege.doc: structure damage dealt by the player to team-owned props (M14 fixed counter)

heal_hp.doc: hit points healed on the player side

heal_event.doc: heal or repair events on the player side

needs: burning props, oil and fire patches kill with cause fire
fire_kill.doc: kills of enemy units by cause fire; countersBy.fire_kill[tag] fans out over the dead unit def tags

needs: virtual field src.indirect (weapon arc high or strike unit)
shell_hit.doc: indirect-fire hits (arc high shells, call_strike) on enemy units; countersBy.shell_hit[def]

air_kill.doc: kills of air-layer units by the player side

reload_hit.doc: damage the player dealt to an enemy unit whose reload is running

reload_hit_taken.doc: damage taken by player units while the hit unit was reloading

cover_hit.doc: damage events on player units that lowCover halved

pin_applied.doc: distinct enemy units that reached a full pin (first time per unit)

armour_flank_hit.doc: hits on an enemy vehicle or armoured unit whose resolved face is side or rear

mine_hit.doc: mine triggers that hit an enemy (mine_trigger {x z team victim kind})

hover_liquid_kill.doc: kills by player hover units over deep water, lava, goo or a rift

cloak_kill.doc: kills by a player unit that was cloaked when its attack began (M14 fixed counter)

emp_hit_machine.doc: distinct enemy machines stunned by a player pulse

strike_kill.doc: kills by a player call_strike or the orbital power within 0.6 s of the explosion (M14 fixed counter)

cover_unit_ticks.doc: sum over ticks of player units with inCover

unit_ticks.doc: sum over ticks of living player units

projectile_launches.doc: projectiles launched (existing event); the trigger of the Modern mission 1 set-piece

banner_fall_crowd.doc: an enemy banner fell while >= 6 allies stood inside its ring (the Medieval mission 2 set-piece trigger)

captures.doc: capture points flipped to the player (M14 fixed counter)

rejectedHelpers.vipSurvived: a VIP death loses the mission, so the helper is a tautology; say vipUntouched(def)
rejectedHelpers.killedFirst: no design uses it and its semantics were never stated
